objective: Implement a bounded reconnect state machine without changing public contracts.
scope: Reconnect state machine and deterministic tests
data_flow: disconnect -> backoff -> reconnect -> watermark validation -> snapshot if gap cannot be proven complete
algorithm_plan: Use bounded exponential backoff with jitter and reject stale watermarks.
contracts: Critical events are never silently dropped.
error_handling: Enter degraded state when reconnect budget is exhausted.
failure_shield: Do not treat reconnect success as proof of event-gap completeness.
test_plan: Unit test reconnect transitions and stale watermark rejection.
evidence_plan: Exact-head test receipt and changed-file list.
observability: Emit reconnect attempt and recovery outcome events.
performance_budgets: Reconnect logic must not block the event loop.

decision_budget.statement: Use bounded exponential backoff with jitter.

stop_condition: All required tests pass at exact head or execution is truthfully BLOCKED.
